title: Listing photo data: US real estate, vacation rental and video prices, MLS photo rules, platform photo requirements and listing photo tools
description:
Open data about real estate listing photos, published by October (october-ai.com/data).

  • Real estate photography prices: published prices of 154 US real estate photographers and photo companies in 24 metros, by home size, with drone, video, twilight and 3D tour add-ons. Each row links to the business's own pricing page and the date it was read (3 November 2026).
  • Real estate video prices: published listing video prices of 125 US videographers and photo companies in 24 metros (video alone and as an add-on, packages, cinematic, reels, agent on camera, drone video), each from the business's own pricing page (18 November 2026).
  • Vacation rental (Airbnb) photography prices: published prices of 63 photographers who shoot vacation rentals in 24 US markets, from each business's own page (18 November 2026).
  • Virtual staging prices: published prices of 27 virtual staging providers (AI tools, designer services, DIY software), each from its own pricing page (18 November 2026).
  • MLS photo rules: photo limits, required shots, branding bans, virtual-staging labels, AI rules and fines at 22 US MLSs, each from the MLS's own published rules.
  • Listing photo requirements by platform: minimum and recommended size, formats, file size cap, photo count, orientation, content and cover photo rules at 11 platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia Group, Zillow Rentals, Apartments.com, Redfin Rental Tools, Furnished Finder, Google Business Profile, Tripadvisor, Peerspace), each from the platform's own pages (17 November 2026).
  • Listing photo apps and services: 58 capture apps, AI editors, editing services, virtual staging, 3D tour and video tools, with price basis, lowest published price and turnaround, each from the vendor's own pages.
  • Professional listing photo benchmarks: 26 measured figures (vertical lean, focal length, brightness profile, saturation, detail) with sample size and method.

CSV and JSON. Each JSON file carries its own field list, licence and changelog. Cite as: Source: October, october-ai.com/data.
